content: ECM compliance patterns relevant to legal: tamper-resistant field-level audit trail (who/what/when/workflow-action, no retroactive edits even by admins); workflow-state logging (draft -> legal review -> approved -> published) satisfies HIPAA/FINRA/SOX-style audit requirements; role/department-based access restriction; retention periods vary by framework (HIPAA 6yr, SOX 7yr) - Skillshare should design audit log and version history to be immutable/append-only from day one.
